body:

replies.author: Mango_
replies.body:
Hello,

Without sufficient evidence that this was unjust, we can't appeal it. Your temp-ban incorporates the fact that you have received numerous chances in the past about breaking the rules. This infraction remains valid.

If you have a complaint regarding the staff team, please email support@avicus.net
